name: Carousel
description: Draggable spring-physics carousel with five transition effects, optional glass frame, round mode, dots, bars or counter indicators, arrows, autoplay and keyboard control.
contents: Row of cards built from items: strings (images), objects with image, title, description and icon, or custom React elements
Optional glass frame panel around the stage
Optional indicator (dots, progress bars or numeric counter) and previous/next arrow buttons
behavior: Spring-based motion with drag, swipe momentum and horizontal trackpad wheel support
Five transition effects: tilt, slide, scale, fade, cube
Optional autoplay that pauses on focus, drag, wheel, hidden tab, offscreen and optionally hover; bars indicator fills as a timer
Keyboard: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End when focused; clicking a side card moves to it
Counter number animates on change; reduced-motion preference disables spring and counter animation
Width follows the container via ResizeObserver; edges fade with a mask when frame is off and effect is not fade or cube
editableByProps: Cards content: images, titles, descriptions, icons or custom elements
Size, aspect ratio, gap, peek, corner radius, round cards, frame on or off
Transition effect, indicator style, arrows, dark or light theme
Autoplay, delay, pause on hover, loop, dragging, start index, change callback

needsCodeEdit.change: Change spring feel of the motion
Change theme colors or add a theme
Change image overlay gradient or card text sizes
Change aria label or arrow labels
needsCodeEdit.where: aria-label attributes in the Carousel return block

fixed: Requires @hugeicons/react and @hugeicons/core-free-icons, Tailwind CSS, and a client component environment
Autoplay wraps back to the first card at the end when loop is off; autoplayDelay is at least 600ms
Unknown effect falls back to tilt; unknown theme falls back to dark
Peek is ignored for fade, cube and round framed modes; peek is capped at 20% of width
Horizontal wheel scrolling over the carousel is captured with preventDefault when draggable
Root is focusable (tabIndex 0) with carousel region ARIA roles and fixed 'Carousel' label
Sample cards are shown when items is omitted
Counter and dot indicators ignore autoplay timing; only bars show a progress fill
Controls are hidden when there is only one item

options.look: Cards sit side by side and rotate around the Y axis as they leave the center
options.useWhen: Feature or product showcase that should feel 3D with neighboring cards visible

options.look: Plain horizontal slide with fading focus on side cards
options.useWhen: Image gallery or logo strip needing a clean, simple swipe

options.look: Side cards shrink and dim while the center card stays full size
options.useWhen: Testimonial or team carousel highlighting one card with neighbors peeking

options.look: One card at a time, crossfading with slight scale
options.useWhen: Hero rotator or quote slider where only one slide should show

options.look: One card at a time turning like a 3D cube face
options.useWhen: Playful promo or product highlight that needs a bold transition
